env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd plat
logos run .
stdout '^plat-ok$'
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/plat_linux.go
exists out/plat_windows.go
! exists out/plat_ignore.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
stdout '^plat-ok$'
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
env GOOS=windows
go build ./...

-- plat/go.mod --
module example.com/plat

go 1.27

-- plat/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println(Platform() + "-ok")
}

-- plat/plat_linux.lgo --
package main

func Platform() string {
	return "plat"
}

-- plat/plat_windows.lgo --
package main

func Platform() string {
	return "plat"
}

-- plat/plat_ignore.lgo --
//go:build ignore

package main

func Ignored() string {
	return "ignored"
}
